notes.title: Propelled Bird announces "Sleeping Souls"
notes.content:
After months of tireless planning, Propelled Bird is happy to announce
[h1]Sleeping Souls![/h1]   Check out the new announcement trailer [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_39zaP47Juc] HERE	[/url]

More details to come in the next few days, be sure to stick around, or better yet, follow us on our social medias!



Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/PropelledBird

notes.title: TesserAct 1.0.4 update LIVE
notes.content:
We know we're not quite on top of the community callings when it comes to bug reports, and we sincerely apologize for that (Partly because we just found out about the community hub)

That aside, we have just made update 1.0.4 LIVE

This fixes the water leak in Chapter 3, as well as a few minor tweaks to the leaks in Chapter 2.

~a beagle

notes.title: Project Pickle: What Propelled Bird has been up to
notes.content:
For the last few months, Propelled Bird has been working on a new project, given the super secret code name "Project Pickle." We've been very hush hush about it, but the veil is soon to be lifted. Be sure to follow the happenings via Propelled Bird's Facebook page. 

https://www.facebook.com/PropelledBird


Soon...
